purpose: sensitivity floor for the holdout confirmation test
selection: fixed by published prior evidence before the confirmation run; not produced by the screen
floor_rule: a control enters the sensitivity-floor denominator only if the discovery screen itself detects it at the same threshold every primary pair had to clear: |beta| >= 0.3 and 95 percent lower bound >= 0.2. A published relationship the discovery panel does not show is reported as such and predicts nothing about the holdout.
